latex.note: The in-house bioRxiv template (an in-house Google Docs template) in LaTeX: article class, US Letter, 0.75 in margins, Helvetica 11 pt, 1.15 spacing, the template's headings, running head with the bioRxiv logo, Nature's reference style written out by pandoc

figures.name: bioRxiv
figures.note: Any size on a US Letter page's text area: up to 7 in (177.8 mm) wide and 9.5 in (241.3 mm) tall, legend aside; up to 180 mm wide, printed scaled to the 7 in text width. One column (3.375 in, 85.7 mm) and full width are presets for prose's in-house bioRxiv two-column template.
figures.source: Matthew's choice for the Monroe lab's bioRxiv preprints (2026-11-16): a US Letter page with 0.75 in margins, as the lab's template has, and 180 mm figures, which he has posted there; bioRxiv itself sets no figure sizes

labels.source: Matthew's choice for bioRxiv (2026-11-16): bold lower-case a, b, c in 8 pt Helvetica, as his posted figures have them and prose's bioRxiv (in house) legends letter them, (a)

text.source: bioRxiv sets no rules for figures (a preprint is posted as the authors' own PDF): no sizes or fonts for figure text

lines.source: bioRxiv sets no rules for figures (a preprint is posted as the authors' own PDF), so Check uses mosaic's 0.25 pt

pictures.source: bioRxiv sets no rules for figures (a preprint is posted as the authors' own PDF), so Check uses mosaic's 300 dpi

export.source: bioRxiv sets no rules for figures (a preprint is posted as the authors' own PDF): any of mosaic's files, in RGB or CMYK, to place in the manuscript
